text_block_list.name: Flight & Bakushin
text_block_list.text: Haa...! Haa...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin O-chan...!!
I won't let you pass...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
...! Me too...!
Nuwaaaaaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The Spring Sprint King has been decided!
The winner is...—

text_block_list.name: Flight Fan A
text_block_list.text: Aaah... Flight-san lost...

text_block_list.name: Flight Fan B
text_block_list.text: Still... that rival showdown with Bakushin O-san was so intense!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I see, even Bakushin O has... a rival.
Even though I thought she'd never lose in speed—

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we're gonna see
an even hotter showdown from here on...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...I see, I see.
A brilliance that brings out the best in each other..."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"This is... irresistibly cute.
And on top of that—Bakushin O-san's incredible speed!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: That light that captivates you in an instant! It's absolutely perfect for Curren♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if Curren can find a good rival too?
I think I'll go look for one♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Is that so. That power at the very end was—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha.
Bwahaha!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Fascinating!
This is simply fascinating, Flight-san—!
Unfortunately, North Flight suffered a defeat.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: I'm deeply frustrated.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"...My raw material is splendid.
Believing that, I have charged forward without looking back..."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Losing in a contest of speed...
To be honest, it's quite a shock.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...Still!
It really is strange.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I'm shocked, but...
my heart's just as full of emotion!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: “It feels like my individuality has clicked right into place...”

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I really want to shine the brightest
on the sprint track!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I'll win...
and prove myself!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Still... Bakushin O-chan
was really strong after all.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure they'll have grown even more by next time.
I have to work hard too!"
Just then—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Flight-san...
Great work today.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin O-chan...
Today ended in a frustrating result for both of us, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
choice_data_list: (Something about her feels... different than usual?)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ...Bakushin O-chan?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The one who won was wonderful.
But... you were incredible too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"So halfway through, realizing I couldn't afford to lose...
my spirit ignited. I was able to push for even greater speed."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I am the strongest, after all. Perfecting my craft...
is something I should be able to do on my own.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Still, that wasn't the case.
It seems you are the one who made me faster.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It really was you!
It had to be you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: The one worthy of being a rival to me—the supreme class representative—is none other than...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I thought it was about time she conquered other GⅠs as well...
but it proved to be premature.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It seems that you and I
must Bakushin even harder!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Next time—
let's meet at the Yasuda Kinen.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Next time... we'll both be even faster!
"The Yasuda Kinen—a Mile G1 held in June... Renowned Umamusume throughout history have claimed victory here, and international Umamusume set their sights on it too."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: 1,600m――my stage.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: "Dressed in my best coordination, I can compete against the Bakushin O of today."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I can't lose.
Next time, without fail...!

The fighting spirit North Flight displayed had grown even stronger.
If so, to ensure victory in the Yasuda Kinen—
choice_data_list: How about entering the Milers Cup?

text_block_list.text: Just as its name suggests, it's a mile race, and many Umamusume use it to get into peak condition before heading to the Yasuda Kinen.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: It's just like during the Fuchu Umamusume Stakes.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Because I figured out my look there...
I was able to deliver a wonderful run in the Shuka Sho.
choice_data_list: Next time, let's be even more fabulous!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
Let's go for... the Milers Cup!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"I'm happy.
That you're suggesting additional races to me."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Back in the Junior Class, we chose races while keeping an eye on the situation, but...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: I've... gotten stronger, haven't I?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
—I'm going on ahead,
Bakushin O-chan!

Before the primary goal, the Yasuda Kinen, where Sakura Bakushin O awaits,
we will use the Yomiuri Milers Cup for fine-tuning.
